Game Overview

Runic Curse is a action game built around stranded on a mysterious island after a storm, Adrian battles the legendary Rune Curse. Engage in dynamic combat, crafting powerful runes and unleashing over 55 spells, as you explore 10 diverse locations filled with formidable foes and epic bosses. Uncover secrets and unleash your magical might.
